Werkse! supports employers with practical matters, such as the TWV: the work permit required to employ someone. For you as an employer, this means: - motivated employees who are eager to get to work; - rapid deployability in practical roles; - strengthening your team; - At the same time, you give substance to social entrepreneurship and contribute to an inclusive labor market in Delft.
